Eli R: Quick follow-up to the gateway streaming model: proposing a lightweight "ownership-transfer" handshake so an edge can switch the active streaming host without full buffer reassembly. Link: https://r.redwood/rfcs/gateway-streams
Maya K: do we need to hold client data during the swap? that'd hurt 99th pct latency for short responses
Eli R: no full buffering. plan: produce a small resume token + seq window. Upstream continues to send; edge coordinates a brief swap window with new owner and then annotates trace with transfer_id
Rita S: cost note: KV cache size grows with resume window. suggest per-model default windows (e.g., 32 tokens for small models, 128 for long-context variants) and a tenant-level delegation quota
Maya K: side-effects worry: resuming could replay an action. propose requiring Idempotency-Key for any request flagged delegable; otherwise reject delegation
Dev Bot: CI-note: any gateway change must include an e2e that simulates owner failover and validates fallback fast-path
Eli R: handshake sketch for SDKs: headers Resume-Token, Resume-Window, Resume-Mode. edge returns Resume-Token when ownership = edge. On transfer, Edge->Gateway: Transfer(Request-Id, Resume-Token, Window) -> Gateway ACK
Maya K: SDK UX: expose boolean "resumable" and emit event "resume_unavailable" if fallback occurs. apps decide UI flow
Rita S: agree to move forward if we cap concurrent transfers and GC orphan tokens after TTL
Eli R: decision lean: implement handshake behind flag edge.experimental.transfer with strict idempotency for side-effecting calls and conservative defaults. Action: Maya -> SDK docs, Rita -> perf sim, Eli -> handshake proto PR, Dev Bot -> add e2e requirement to deploy checklist
Maya K: tagging infra for quota guidance @infra-team
Eli R: will update RFC with decision and include trace annotations + example header snippets. :thumbsup:
